/1.note: Limits comparison to one side and composes with /8

/8.note: Limits comparison to eight sectors per track and composes with /1

/1.note: Copies one side and produces a single-sided target image

/STA.note: Short status synonym reaches the live code-page query

/STATUS.note: Long status synonym reports the active resident code page

/B.note: Background-printing mode loads and returns to the batch

/LCD.note: LCD aspect mode loads and returns to the batch

/PB.note: Short printbox synonym loads STD and drives an exact printer-stream contract

/PRINTBOX.note: Long printbox synonym loads the same named STD profile

/R.note: Reverse-printing mode loads and returns to the batch

/F.note: Adds filenames to the directory tree

/A.note: Copies archived files without clearing the source archive bit

/D.note: Date threshold includes and excludes deterministic source dates

/E.note: Includes an empty source directory when combined with /S

/M.note: Copies archived files and clears the source archive bit

/P.note: Prompts for each source and copies both accepted files

/V.note: Verified copying produces the exact destination payload

/W.note: Waits for supplied input before copying
